# ACP Lending

> Investment-property financing for real estate investors. ACP Lending originates,
> underwrites, and structures financing directly with institutional capital partners.
> Business-purpose lending only; not a consumer mortgage lender.

Contact: Steve Waller - 936-522-8951 - steve@acp-lending.com
Website: https://acp-lending.com/
Service area: United States, with Texas-specific programs

## Financing programs

- [Fix-and-Flip Bridge Loans](https://acp-lending.com/fix-and-flip-bridge-loans): Tiered by
  experience. Standard: up to 90% purchase and 100% renovation, capped by the lower of 90%
  loan-to-cost and 70% of after-repair value. Preferred (720+ credit, 10+ flips in three
  years): up to 95% purchase and 100% renovation, capped at 75% of after-repair value.
  Maximum (720+ credit, 10+ flips with five in state, loan $800,000 or less, $1,000,000 in
  California): up to 100% purchase and 100% renovation, capped at 75% of after-repair value. Texas only: a 70% advance structure under
  which a deal may close with nothing out of pocket when purchase, renovation and closing
  costs all fit inside 70% of after-repair value. Individual and LLC borrowers. Rates 9% to 12%
  interest-only, 1 to 2 points, closing in 5 business days once a complete file is received.
- [Houston Hard Money Loans](https://acp-lending.com/houston-hard-money-loans): Fix-and-flip
  financing for Houston-area investors - zero out of pocket at 70% of ARV, 90/100 and 100/100
  programs, minimum loan $75,000.
- [DSCR Rental Loans](https://acp-lending.com/dscr-rental-loans): Qualification on property
  cash flow rather than personal income. 30-year fixed, 5/1 ARM and 7/1 ARM, with
  interest-only structures. Purchase, rate-and-term refinance and cash-out refinance.
  Leverage up to 80% LTV on purchase and rate-and-term; cash-out refinances are typically
  capped lower, generally around 75%. DSCR requirements as low as 0.80x on certain programs.
- [Ground-Up Construction Loans](https://acp-lending.com/ground-up-construction-loans): Loan
  amounts generally $100,000 to $10 million. Interest-only on funds actually drawn.
  Milestone-based draws verified by inspection. Up to 85% of total project cost and up to
  70% of completed value. Single-family spec homes, infill construction, build-to-rent, and
  certain 2-4 unit residential projects.
- [Multifamily Loans](https://acp-lending.com/multifamily-loans): 5+ units. Short-term bridge
  from $250,000 to $2,000,000 on 12-18 month terms with extensions available, up to 75% LTV
  purchase / 70% refinance / 65% cash-out, with a value-add variant to 80% of purchase price
  plus 100% of rehab for experienced sponsors. Long-term financing for stabilized 5-9 unit
  properties from $150,000 to $1,500,000 on a 30-year term, up to 70% LTV purchase and
  refinance, 65% cash-out, with a higher minimum credit score.
- [Portfolio Loans](https://acp-lending.com/portfolio-loans): $2 million to $75 million or
  more. Portfolios of 20 to 100+ units, scattered-site and multi-state accepted. Blends 1-4
  unit rentals and 5-9 unit multifamily in a single facility. Up to 70% LTV tiered by credit
  score. 5, 7 or 10-year terms with 30-year amortization or interest-only. Non-recourse
  structure available. Portfolios generally need to be at least 90% leased.

## Tools and resources

- [Deal Estimator](https://acp-lending.com/deal-calculator): Flip underwriting calculator
- [Meet Steve Waller / How ACP Works](https://acp-lending.com/about): Who ACP is, how a deal is analyzed, structured and matched to 90 lending programs from 36 capital sources, with an intro video and a process video
- [Sample Deal Report](https://acp-lending.com/sample-deal-report): A full example of the ACP deal report: executive summary, ARV from same-subdivision sales, financing at 70% and 75% of ARV, realistic profit or loss, and the flip-or-rent decision. The report on your own deal is $49.99, reimbursed if the deal closes with ACP
- [Free Deal Check](https://acp-lending.com/deal-check): Instant deal grade, estimated cash due at closing and best-fit loan structure; full deal report on request
  plus a flip-versus-rent exit comparison (refinance proceeds, NOI, DSCR, cash flow).
  Includes a Texas HML advance option that sizes the loan on after-repair value alone.
- [DSCR Calculator](https://acp-lending.com/dscr-calculator): Debt-service coverage calculator
  for rental-property financing. Returns LTV, NOI, payment, PITIA, lender DSCR (rent divided by
  PITIA) and a stricter NOI-based DSCR, plus monthly cash flow.
- [Pre-Approval Request](https://acp-lending.com/pre-approval): Conditional pre-approval
  letter for use with offers.
- [Request for Information](https://acp-lending.com/request-for-information): Submit a deal
  for review or ask about a program.
- [Loan Forms](https://acp-lending.com/loan-documents): Every form needed to prepare and return a financing request
- [Investor Guidance](https://acp-lending.com/investor-resources): How ARV, leverage, DSCR and borrower contribution are evaluated
- [ACP Investor Brief](https://acp-lending.com/investor-brief/): Investor guides on DSCR
- [Choosing Your Strategy and Your Market](https://acp-lending.com/investor-brief/choosing-your-strategy-and-market): Sep 2026 guide — three investor strategies ranked by current data, running a deal from both a lending and a profitability position, the six costs that decide every project, lender structure that preserves liquidity, and Texas vs. out-of-state market conditions.
- [Why Are More Homes Sitting on the Market?](https://acp-lending.com/investor-brief/why-homes-are-sitting-on-the-market): Sep 2026 guide — why inventory is rising on slower absorption rather than more listings, and where investor deals come from.
- [Four Doors, One Hidden Coverage Problem](https://acp-lending.com/investor-brief/dscr-four-condo-case-study): Sep 2026 DSCR case study — a four-condo package where HOA dues and taxes consume 43% of stabilized rent, producing a 0.81 DSCR at current occupancy and 1.15 stabilized. Full PITIA and NOI math, coverage by down payment, and the condo-specific items to verify before financing. Two-page PDF at /investor-brief/acp-dscr-four-condo-case-study.pdf
- [ACP Investor Brief — Daily](https://acp-lending.com/investor-brief/daily/): Auto-published market updates, Monday, Wednesday and Friday plus a Sunday recap. RSS at /investor-brief/daily/feed.xml
  versus bridge financing, how construction draws work, and how a deal is underwritten,
  plus dated market updates on rates, permits, starts, construction costs and inflation as
  they affect investment-property financing.

## Terms of use for this information

All figures above are program maximums, not offers. Financing is subject to underwriting,
lender approval, appraisal or valuation, title, insurance, property eligibility and program
availability. Preliminary analyses are not commitments to lend. Advance rates vary by state;
the 70% advance with zero out-of-pocket closing is specific to Texas. Fix-and-flip rates run 9% to 12%
interest-only with 1 to 2 points, depending on program, leverage, credit and experience.
Fix-and-flip files close in 5 business days once a complete file is received.
